# TDPdf v1.23.1.0

**Fixes a crash introduced in 1.23.0.0. Please upgrade as soon as this reaches you.**

TDPdf has protected itself since 1.8.1.0 against a Windows display race that could close the application while it was laying out the page grid. 1.23.0.0 reorganised the shared code that recognises that race and, in doing so, narrowed it too far — the protection stopped recognising the very crash it exists for, and the application began closing again. One user hit it fourteen times before it was found.

This release restores the protection. Nothing else from 1.23.0.0 changes: telemetry, the privacy setting and everything else behave exactly as they did.

## For administrators

The Intune detection rule now requires 1.23.1.0, so managed machines pick this up on the next evaluation. Assignments are unaffected.

If you are still on 1.22.1.0 or earlier you were never exposed to this — the regression exists only in 1.23.0.0.

## Verifying this download

The executable is signed by *The Doodle Project Code Signing*, a private certificate. On managed machines that trust it, the signature validates. On a machine that does not, Windows will still warn on first run. Use `SHA256SUMS.txt` to confirm the download independently.
